name: Gellco Work Outfitters
old_description: Gellco Clothing & Shoes is Oklahoma’s leading provider of Safety Footwear. With over 20 name brands and well over 200 different styles in-stock we offer by far the largest selection in the great state of Oklahoma. Gellco offers safety footwear in just about any style, category, safety feature, and price range imaginable. We know that Safety Footwear is not a one size fits all.
about:
Founded in 1959 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, Gellco Clothing & Shoes began as a retailer of occupational footwear and work apparel for the American worker. The company has remained privately held and expanded to five brick-and-mortar locations across Oklahoma City, Edmond, Broken Arrow, and Tulsa.

Today Gellco operates as a distributor and service provider for safety footwear, flame-resistant clothing, and workwear accessories. It stocks more than 20 name brands and over 200 styles in its stores, and deploys a fleet of six mobile shoe trucks that carry upwards of 1,000 pairs directly to job sites at no extra charge. A central shipping center in Oklahoma enables delivery to most U.S. destinations within three to five business days. The company also manages corporate programs that include customized online catalogs, flexible invoicing, reporting, payroll deduction, and custom embroidery for logos.

Gellco serves industrial and corporate customers ranging from small crews of five to workforces of 5,000 employees. Its client base spans sectors that require OSHA-compliant protective footwear and flame-resistant garments, such as construction, energy, manufacturing, and utilities. The staff is trained on OSHA PPE standards and assists with product selection for specific work environments.

The company differentiates itself through its breadth of inventory, mobile service convenience, and a service model that emphasizes personal customer support. Gellco’s corporate programs are tailored to each account, with proactive communication on backorders and alternative product suggestions to keep crews equipped.
